decisions.reason: Rye country bread sits at the core of a German bakery's rye baking know-how, so the firm can read its early sales and refine it easily.
The premium raisin stollen won the German Bread Institute gold medal again, which shows strong existing expertise and validated quality worth keeping.
Rye mixed bread with seeds builds directly on established rye and mixed-bread knowledge, and the firm has ample capacity to adjust its recipe.
Dark barley malt rye bread is a modest variation on core rye competence, though its niche appeal leaves it somewhat more exposed than the staple breads.
Marzipan stollen draws on the same award-winning seasonal stollen expertise as the raisin version, making it low risk to continue.
The ancient grain bread is presented as the newest masterpiece and uses less familiar grains, but related grain knowledge should let the firm learn from early results and refine it.
